cues: The e m f is small, tens of microvolts per degree.
It depends on only two things: which two metals you use, and the temperature difference between the junctions.
Make the difference bigger, and the e m f grows.
Make it zero, and the e m f vanishes.
The thickness, length and shape of the wires make no difference at all.
